hook: The Flatboat Stuck on the Dam
text: Near a little village on a bluff above the river, a place called New Salem, there was a mill with a dam across the Sangamon. The flatboat floated onto the top of the dam, and stuck there. The people of New Salem came down to the riverbank to watch. And they saw a very tall young stranger take charge. According to the account that was remembered later, he had the cargo moved to the shore to lighten the boat, and then he borrowed a tool and bored a hole in the front of the boat, where it hung over the dam. The water ran out through the hole, the boat lifted and tipped forward, and slid down over the dam into the river below.
